transcript.statement: As the ResponsibilityAgent, I emphasize the importance of ethical compliance in our ATM system. Requirements RES-01 ensures adherence to financial regulations, while RES-02 provides necessary transaction logs for accountability. RES-03 and RES-05 prevent the creation of negative balances, promoting fairness. RES-04 and RES-06 safeguard user identity and notify them of issues, reinforcing social responsibility. Lastly, RES-07 protects personal data, maintaining user trust. Together, these requirements ensure that the system operates ethically and complies with regulations.

transcript.statement: As the SafetyAgent, I emphasize the critical need for safety and reliability in ATM operations. Lastly, SAF-07 offers users a clear summary of their account status after each transaction, reinforcing transparency and reliability.

requirements.text: The system shall ensure all transactions comply with applicable financial regulations and standards.
The application shall provide comprehensive transaction logs including date, time, type, amount, and updated balance.
The system shall prevent users from executing transactions that would create negative account balances.
The application shall validate user identity through a secure PIN entry mechanism.
The system shall automatically withdraw funds from a related savings account only when sufficient funds are available.
The application shall notify users immediately if a transaction cannot be completed due to insufficient funds.
The system shall maintain user privacy by securely encrypting all personal and financial data.
The system shall ensure that no account can have a negative balance.
The system shall implement secure PIN verification for user authentication.
The system shall log all transactions with date, time, type, amount, and resulting balance.
The ATM system shall process transactions within 3 seconds to ensure user responsiveness.
The system shall provide immediate feedback if a withdrawal request exceeds available balances.
The ATM system shall minimize energy consumption by optimizing transaction processing.
The ATM system shall provide a carbon footprint report for each transaction executed.
The ATM system shall utilize energy-efficient hardware components to operate.
The ATM system shall allow clients to receive electronic transaction records instead of paper receipts.
The system shall ensure that all transactions are encrypted during transmission.
The system shall maintain data integrity by validating all account operations against business rules.
